title: The forgetful functor on module objects is faithful
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a monoidal category and $\mathcal R$ a monoid object of $\mathcal C$.
The forgetful functor $\Mod_{\mathcal R}(\mathcal C)\to\mathcal C$ of
[sk-def-sfb-module-objects] is faithful.

proof.text:
A morphism of module objects is a morphism of $\mathcal C$ that satisfies a condition.
So two morphisms of module objects with the same underlying morphism are equal.
